about: Each change to frozen bridge code against the merge base, with one reason: moved (a rule moved into Rust, naming its task), refactor (behaviour kept), gone (an entry that left the freeze) or main (a change main made, merged by this change: the full SHA of the main commit, then its title). Entries the merge base already holds are spent and may be pruned.
